description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer, surrogate, and copier for the ImmutableSortedSet<T> collection in Orleans.Serialization. It defines how to serialize, deserialize, and deep copy ImmutableSortedSet instances, including handling of key comparers and surrogate types.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableSortedSet<T>, handling conversion to and from surrogate representations.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type used for serializing ImmutableSortedSet<T>, containing list of values and key comparer.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableSortedSet<T>, supporting deep copy and shallow copy detection.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate representation back into an ImmutableSortedSet<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableSortedSet<T> into its surrogate representation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an ImmutableSortedSet<T>, utilizing the provided copier for elements.
